mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing the temperature and door-opening logs was the most worthwhile decision: it connected the spikes to a plausible cause while making clear that air readings do not establish stored-object temperatures.

leastWorthwhile.text: The filter-to-cabinet attempt was the least clear passage: I expected to refit the filter directly, but the game redirected it to the fan cartridge instead.

surprise.text: The cleaned filter and replacement fan formed a complete air module before installation; I had expected the filter to go straight into the cabinet.

arbitrary.text: The final combination had a clear purpose, though I was guessing that joining the forecast to the monitored cooler would produce the completed investigation.

continue.text: Yes. I'd be curious to see how the neighbors handle the supply warning; the practical repair and careful treatment of uncertain evidence made this chapter engaging.
